title: UnitRegistryValidator
responsibility: Checks active registry identities, source ownership, declared relationships and reviewed canonical dependency boundaries.

inputs.name: UnitRegistryValidator.validate.manifests
inputs.description: The registry manifests to validate. Only active entries participate in identity, ownership, relationship and source checks; all manifests remain available as candidates for predecessor lineage.

inputs.name: UnitRegistryValidator.validate.files
inputs.description: The set of source paths present in the indexed repository. Each active unit produces a missing-source diagnostic for every owned path absent from this set.

inputs.name: UnitRegistryValidator.validate.sources
inputs.description: An optional map of indexed source facts for canonical import inspection. If omitted, duplicate identity checks still run but canonical source dependency inspection is skipped.

inputs.name: registryOwnershipFindings.identifiers
inputs.description: The IDs of active units supplied for duplicate detection. Repeated IDs produce one diagnostic per repeated ID.

inputs.name: registryOwnershipFindings.units
inputs.description: The active manifests considered for canonical dependency inspection. Only units in the fixed reviewed-owner set are inspected, and only when sources is supplied.

inputs.name: registryOwnershipFindings.sources
inputs.description: An optional map of indexed source facts used to inspect owned sources of reviewed canonical owners. If omitted, the function returns duplicate identity findings without inspecting source dependencies.

outputs.name: UnitRegistryValidator.validate
outputs.description: The diagnostic strings produced by the active-manifest composition, ownership, source, helper, config, dependency and lineage checks. The array is empty when those checks find no issues.

outputs.name: registryOwnershipFindings
outputs.description: The duplicate active-ID diagnostics and, when sources is supplied, canonical import findings for reviewed owners. An unread owned source produces a diagnostic, while an owned path absent from the map is skipped.
